summary: This feature allows users to add frequently accessed ERP options, such as 'Collect Fee', to a dedicated quick links section on their dashboard for convenient daily access.
steps: Identify an ERP option that you use frequently (e.g., 'Collect Fee').
Locate the 'Quick Link' option on your dashboard or next to the desired menu item.
Add the selected option to your quick links.
The added link will appear on your dashboard for direct access.
business_rules: Quick links are user-specific, meaning each user can customize their own set of links.
important_notes: An 'N' number of links can be added and updated according to individual user preferences.
questions: How can I add a quick link to my ERP dashboard?
What is the purpose of quick links in the ERP?
Can I customize the quick links on my dashboard?
